open CategoryTheory in
theorem lg_target {C : Type*} [Category C] {X Y Z : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) [IsIso f] [IsIso g] : IsIso (f ≫ g) := by
  let f_inv : Y ⟶ X := isoInv f
  let g_inv : Z ⟶ Y := isoInv g
  let h : Z ⟶ X := g_inv ≫ f_inv
  have : h ≫ (f ≫ g) = id _ := by
    rw [assoc, ← comp_id]
    exact id_comp f_inv
  have : (f ≫ g) ≫ h = id _ := by
    rw [assoc, ← comp_id]
    exact id_comp g_inv
  exact IsIso.mk h
